modes.comment: Default push-only (same policy as ASR on shared hosting). FreeSaaS asr_push_enabled + edge-host service «diarize». Set pull=true only for labs without gateway.

model.comment: Default: CAM++-LM ONNX 512-d. backend=mlx only for ResNet34 weights.npz (no CAM++ MLX yet).

filter.comment: Restrict claim: day=YYYY-MM-DD and/or admin id; lookback days when day empty (default 3). Claim prefers ID_ADMIN>0 for enrollment.

comment: Standalone enricher for records that already have ASR but no speakers. Whisper can also call diarize.engine locally after SRT.
